verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a documented workspace-level REST API reference covering types, paths, and request/response payloads with examples (docs-65, supp-api-reference-examples). The APIs are versioned with migration guidance (supp-versioned-apis, supp-api-versioning), and Unity Catalog objects are explicitly manageable via REST (docs-56), backed by an official SDK and CLI (docs-49, docs-2). missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), a live try-it runner, independent hands-on corroboration, and full programmatic coverage (a community report says usage info is hard to get programmatically).
